message:
You know that moment when you realize you’ve been so busy preparing for the unexpected that you’ve accidentally created a comedy of errors in your own home? Just the other day, we were frantically packing our go-bags for a weekend camping trip. In the midst of packing snacks and blankets, I found myself rummaging through drawers for important documents, only to discover I’d stashed our family’s insurance papers in a shoebox labeled ‘Holiday Decorations.’ 

It made us laugh, but it also reminded us how important it is to have a system in place—so we’re not searching through the shoebox of chaos next time life throws us a curveball. Sometimes, being prepared can lead to unexpected giggles! What about you? Have you ever found something in a surprising place? 😄
